Higher Education Committee
Tuesday, March 14, 2023
3:00 PM, Room G-15, Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm

S.F. 2603: Senator Kupec: Minnesota State Colleges and Universities appropriations.

Senator Kupec moved that S.F. 2603, be laid over.

S.F. 2636: Senator Murphy: University of Minnesota operations and maintenance appropriation.

Senator Murphy moved that S.F. 2636, be laid over.

S.F. 2075: Senator Fateh: Funding and policy related changes provision for the Office of Higher Education, Minnesota State
Colleges and Universities, the University of Minnesota and the Mayo Clinic.

Gavel was transferred to Vice Chair Putnam at 4:30pm for the duration of the meeting

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 2075, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 5:00pm

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer, L&gislative Assistant
